item.title: Woman hospitalised following collision on Ramelton road - Highland Radio - Latest Donegal News and Sport
item.description: A woman was hospitalised following a road traffic collision in Letterkenny yesterday. The single-vehicle crash took place on the Ramelton Road at approximately 3:40pm. The driver of the car, a woman aged in her 70s, was taken to Letterkenny University Hospital as a precaution following this incident. The Ramelton Road is currently open for use.
